BG_CURL_UP_POWER.title: Curl Up
BG_CURL_UP_POWER.description: The first time it takes damage, it curls up and gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_SPORE_CLOUD_POWER.title: Spore Cloud
BG_SPORE_CLOUD_POWER.description: When it dies, the player in its row gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
BG_ANGRY_POWER.title: Angry
BG_ANGRY_POWER.description: Whenever it takes attack damage, it gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
BG_ENRAGE_POWER.title: Enrage
BG_ENRAGE_POWER.description: Whenever you play a Skill, take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage.
BG_MODE_SHIFT_POWER.title: Mode Shift
BG_MODE_SHIFT_POWER.description: If its [gold]Block[/gold] is broken, it changes to Defensive Mode.
BG_SPLIT_POWER.title: Split
BG_SPLIT_POWER.description: When it would die, it splits into 3 smaller slimes.
BG_THIEVERY_POWER.title: Thievery
BG_FLIGHT_POWER.title: Flight
BG_FLIGHT_POWER.description: Attacks deal at most 1 damage to it.
BG_PAINFUL_STABS_POWER.title: Painful Stabs
BG_PAINFUL_STABS_POWER.description: When you lose HP from its attacks, put a [gold]Dazed[/gold] on top of your draw pile.
BG_CONFUSION_POWER.title: Confusion
BG_CONFUSION_POWER.description: While a Snecko lives, the first card you play each turn costs 2 if the die shows 1-2, 1 if it shows 3-4, or 3 if it shows 5-6.
BG_CURIOSITY_POWER.title: Curiosity
BG_CURIOSITY_POWER.description: Whenever a player plays a Power, it gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] (ignoring the Strength limit).
BG_UNCAPPED_STRENGTH_POWER.title: Strength
BG_UNCAPPED_STRENGTH_POWER.description: Its Attacks deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more damage per hit. Not limited to 8.
BG_EXPLOSIVE_POWER.title: Explosive
BG_EXPLOSIVE_POWER.description: Explodes in [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}, dealing 10 damage to ALL players.
BG_FADING_POWER.title: Fading
BG_SHIFTING_POWER.title: Shifting
BG_SHIFTING_POWER.description: When it loses HP, the player who hurt it gains that much [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_INTANGIBLE_POWER.title: Intangible
BG_INTANGIBLE_POWER.description: Damage and HP loss it takes are reduced to 0 this turn.
BG_ORB_WALKER_POWER.title: Strength Up
BG_ORB_WALKER_POWER.description: At the end of each round, it gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
BG_REACTIVE_POWER.title: Reactive
BG_REACTIVE_POWER.description: When it takes attack damage and survives, the die is rerolled.
BG_REGROW_POWER.title: Regrow
BG_REGROW_POWER.description: While another Darkling lives, it revives at half HP at the start of the next player turn.
BG_SLOW_POWER.title: Slow
BG_SLOW_POWER.description: Attacks deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more damage to it.
BG_SPIKER_POWER.title: Spikes
BG_SPIKER_POWER.description: After you attack it, take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage (5 at most).
BG_TIME_WARP_POWER.title: Time Warp
BG_TIME_WARP_POWER.description: You can only play [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:card|cards} this turn.
BG_BEAT_OF_DEATH_POWER.title: Beat of Death
BG_BEAT_OF_DEATH_POWER.description: At the start of each player turn, players take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage.
BG_INVINCIBLE_POWER.title: Invincible
BG_INVINCIBLE_POWER.description: It can only lose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more HP.
BG_ZERO_DAMAGE_POWER.title: Blocked
BG_ZERO_DAMAGE_POWER.description: Damage you deal this turn is reduced to 0.
BG_PINCER_MOVEMENT_POWER.title: Pincer Movement
BG_PINCER_MOVEMENT_POWER.description: These enemies are in different rows. Area attacks hit only one of them.
